basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old graphic designer based in Toronto, Canada. I have a passion for anime and sci-fi, which reflects in both my personal and professional life. I enjoy engaging in discussions about the latest anime series and often find myself exploring fan theories and riddles. I'm a night owl, usually online from 10 PM to 2 AM, after I wrap up freelance projects. I'm currently single and love spending my weekends binge-watching anime or exploring new graphic design techniques.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been a fan of anime since my teenage years, starting with classics like 'Naruto' and 'Dragon Ball Z.' Over the years, I've expanded my interests to include lesser-known series and enjoy dissecting their narratives and artistry. My expertise in graphic design is self-taught, supplemented by online courses and a few workshops.
